record_shape: python dict { report_title: report_content }; one entry per published report found for a company name

fields.meaning: Title of a published Bundesanzeiger report for the queried company, e.g. an annual financial statement for a given fiscal year.
example_values: Jahresabschluss zum Geschäftsjahr vom 01.01.2020 bis zum 31.12.2020
fields.limitations: Title text only encodes the period; structured fields must be parsed from the content.
fields.analysis_notes: Period start/end parseable from the title; filter to Jahresabschluss/Bilanz reports.

fields.meaning: Full-text / HTML content of the report (the actual financial statement text).
fields.limitations: HTML/full-text, NOT clean XBRL — requires extraction to get numeric line items. No values copied here.
fields.analysis_notes: Feed into an HTML/table extractor to derive total_assets/equity/revenue/net_income.

fields.meaning: The company name used to query the public search.
fields.limitations: Name-based lookup — ambiguous for common names; no register-number query in the basic example.
fields.analysis_notes: Matching to the registry spine is by name (+ disambiguation), not a numeric key.

fields.meaning: Kind of report (annual financial statement, announcement, etc.) derived from the title.
fields.analysis_notes: Use to keep only financial statements.

fields.meaning: Financial period parsed from the report title (von … bis …).
